input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I checked, and my messaging app currently cannot send MMS messages. What should I try next?

Looking at my phone’s status bar, I see that my signal strength is excellent and I’m connected to 5G, but it looks like mobile data is currently disabled. Regular calls seem to work fine, but I’m not able to use mobile data at the moment. What should I do next?
I’ve turned mobile data on, but I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else I should try?
I checked my APN settings, and the MMSC URL is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Is that correct, or should I try something else?
I reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone, but I still can’t send MMS messages. This is getting a bit frustrating—what else can I try?
I turned off Wi-Fi Calling as you suggested, but I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What should I try next?
I checked my messaging app’s permissions, and both storage and SMS permissions are already enabled. I tried sending an MMS again, but it still doesn’t work. What else can we try?
Thank you for checking! I’d like to add 2GB of data to my line, but I don’t want to change my plan. Please go ahead and add the extra data so I can try sending MMS messages again.
Great news—I just checked, and I’m now able to send MMS messages again! Thank you for your help in resolving this issue.
Thank you so much for your help and patience! I appreciate the support. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###

Since your mobile data is currently disabled, that would prevent MMS from working, as MMS requires mobile data to be enabled. 

Please enable mobile data on your phone. You can usually do this by:
1. Going to your phone’s Settings.
2. Selecting “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
3. Toggling the “Mobile Data” switch to ON.

Once you’ve enabled mobile data, try sending an MMS again. Let me know if it works or if you encounter any issues.
